$comment: Dex-written content for the ENT era (#641), merged over the mod's text by pipeline/dexpipe/content.py. "auto" fields are derived from the ship's own weapons, abilities and research.

description.summary: An early automated work craft that patches up damaged ships and builds the stations and subsystems a young Starfleet needs.
A fast, unarmed United Earth scout, built to go ahead of the fleet and chart what lies beyond. It carries no weapons, so it relies on speed and distance to stay alive.

Earth's first warp-5 starship and the pride of the NX programme. As the fleet's flagship she leads from the front, launching new construction and serving as a mobile base for the ships around her.
Every Earth ship that follows owes her something. Her crew went further than any humans before them and wrote the book on deep space as they went, and to fly under her flag is to stand at the start of everything Starfleet will become.
A light destroyer fitted with boarding pods as well as phasers and spatial torpedoes, able to seize enemy ships rather than destroy them.

A Hague-class forward base, among the first that United Earth pushed out beyond its own system. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps enemy fleets from jumping in on top of it.
A United Earth destroyer from the years of the Romulan War, trading the NX class's endurance for heavier guns and a faster turn of speed.

fed_ENT_poseidon.source: Memory Beta, Poseidon class (Star Trek: Legacy).

description.summary: A small United Earth cargo bee fitted with mining gear. It cuts dilithium from asteroids and ferries it home to the nearest freighter or outpost.
A J-class cargo hauler converted to process dilithium in the field. It carries and maintains its own flight of mining bees, so the fleet's fuel is refined where it's mined.
Enterprise's little two-seat shuttlepod, pressed into service as a strike craft. Fragile, but useful for scouting and drawing fire, and dangerous to larger ships in numbers.
One of United Earth's first true battleships, built for the line of battle rather than exploration. Slow, but it can take and deal a great deal of punishment.
A rugged little work craft that repairs the Empire's ships and raises new stations and subsystems wherever the warriors go.

The flagship of the Klingon fleet, a heavily armed command ship that builds and launches new warships as it advances. Where it goes, the battle follows.
No Klingon is given a flagship; it is taken, by deeds the Empire cannot ignore. Her commander answers only to the Council, and her crew sing of her victories in the halls of their Houses.

A Kan'Qul-class forward base, the Empire's foothold on a new frontier. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps raiders from jumping in on top of it.
A Klingon cargo bee fitted with mining gear, cutting dilithium from asteroids to keep the Empire's war fleets fuelled.
The Empire's first orbital shipyard of the era. It builds destroyers and light to medium cruisers and can dock one ship at a time for repairs.
An attack bomber built to slip past escorts and put torpedoes into enemy capital ships.
A discreet automated work craft that repairs Romulan ships and builds new stations and subsystems out of sight of the enemy.

The warbird that led the Romulan fleets against Earth, armed with a mass accelerator cannon alongside its disruptors and torpedoes. It builds and launches new ships from its own bays.
Admiral Valdore led the Romulan war against Earth from her decks. To serve aboard her is to stand close to the Senate's own purpose, and every captain in the fleet watches her signals for their orders, and for any sign of displeasure.
A nimble light cruiser that carries an EMP projector to knock out enemy systems before its disruptors close in.
A Jaltak-class forward base guarding the Star Empire's borders. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, while its warp inhibitor keeps intruders from jumping in unannounced.
A Romulan cargo bee fitted with mining gear. It works the asteroid fields quietly, carrying dilithium back to the nearest freighter or outpost.
A Romulan mining freighter that processes dilithium in the field and carries and maintains its own flight of mining bees.
A Romulan orbital shipyard that builds destroyers and light to medium cruisers, with a single repair berth.
A small, fast Tholian vessel armed with a tetryon beam. Working in pairs and groups, these ships spin energy webs that can trap and crush a far larger opponent.

thl_ENT_webspinner.source: Memory Beta, Spinner class; Memory Alpha, Tholian web. Crew: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 129.
